answer: An agent marketplace handling copper deliveries, grove maintenance, and jetty repairs requires each registered agent to lock $100 in escrow for 90 days before it can bid, with one active bid per deposit. Creating more names grants no free bidding capacity: an attacker seeking 10,000 simultaneous bids must immobilize $1 million. The defense makes influence scale with committed capital, while the lock imposes financing costs even if every deposit is later returned.
